verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is API-first: its core capabilities are exposed programmatically through the Python `AsyncWebCrawler.arun` API, a Dockerized FastAPI server, an official CLI and an official MCP server. Its only UI surfaces are an interactive playground that itself generates request code and a monitoring dashboard, so the UI largely mirrors the API. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence that monitoring-dashboard metrics are exposed via the API, a published OpenAPI spec (the openapi probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
